results.title: A Story of Derry
results.overview: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

results.title: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
results.original_title: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
results.overview: Three scouts and lifelong friends join forces with one badass cocktail waitress to become the world’s most unlikely team of heroes.  When their peaceful town is ravaged by a zombie invasion, they’ll fight for the badge of a lifetime and put their scouting skills to the test to save mankind from the undead.

results.title: Remain Calm
results.overview: The story follows the two gas station clerks whose routine night shift turns into a fight for survival. A government agent warns them about Mr. Frett, a terrifying creature that tracks and hunts people who show any signs of anxiety, stress, or panic. To stay alive, the characters must force themselves into a state of aggressive positivity and calm.

results.title: Spiral: From the Book of Saw
results.original_title: Spiral: From the Book of Saw
results.overview: Working in the shadow of an esteemed police veteran, brash Detective Ezekiel “Zeke” Banks and his rookie partner take charge of a grisly investigation into murders that are eerily reminiscent of the city’s gruesome past.  Unwittingly entrapped in a deepening mystery, Zeke finds himself at the center of the killer’s morbid game.

results.title: The Exorcist: Martyrs
results.overview: Thirteen years ago, New York City detective Julie Miller ended the terror reign of satanic serial killer Father Sunday. The case made her a hero, and she has thrown herself into her work ever since. Now a new killer scrawls her name in an altar boy's blood on the walls of a church crypt, dragging her back into the darkness she believed she had buried with him.

results.title: As the Gods Will
results.overview: High school student Shun Takahata is bored. Bored with the day-to-day monotony of school and life, he prays for change, for something exciting. Suddenly, he and his classmates are forced to play deadly children's games and facing terrifying creatures from a talking Daruma doll to a sharp-clawed lucky cat.

results.title: Terrifier
results.overview: After witnessing a brutal murder on Halloween night, a young woman becomes the next target of a maniacal entity.

results.title: Michael Jackson's Thriller
results.overview: A night at the movies turns terrifying when Michael and his date are attacked by zombies.

results.title: Family Guy Happy Hell-o-ween
results.overview: After unexpectedly dying and being sent to Hell, Stewie and Brian’s constant nagging leads The Devil to quit, passing control of Hell to them.

results.title: A Quiet Place Part III
results.overview: The third installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

results.title: Jason
results.overview: Plot TBA. The thirteenth installment in the "Friday the 13th" franchise.

results.title: Insidious Possession
results.overview: A former A-student begins lashing out in school and at home. Her parents reach out to their priest for help. Only to realize that the girl is possessed by the devil. Now the unexperienced priest must fight for the girl’s soul and the souls of the entire town.

results.title: Mater and the Ghostlight
results.overview: Mater, the rusty but trusty tow truck from Cars, spends a day in Radiator Springs playing scary pranks on his fellow townsfolk. That night at Flo's V8 Café, the Sheriff tells the story of the legend of the Ghostlight, and as everyone races home Mater is left alone primed for a good old-fashioned scare.

results.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Kreepaway Kamp
results.overview: While at Kamp Koral for a reunion, SpongeBob and the gang are stalked by a mysterious figure lurking in the shadows as campers start disappearing one by one!

results.title: Terrifier 4
results.overview: The fourth and last installment in the Terrifier franchise. Plot TBA.

results.title: Anything but Ghosts
results.overview: When a group of fame-seeking wannabe "ghosthunters" find themselves in over their heads, things spiral wildly and terrifyingly out of control.

results.title: Scared Shrekless
results.overview: Shrek challenges Donkey, Puss in Boots and his other fairy tale character friends to spend the night in Lord Farquaad's haunted castle, telling scary stories to see who can resist becoming scared and stay the longest.

results.title: DC Showcase - Constantine: The House of Mystery
results.original_title: DC Showcase - Constantine: The House of Mystery
results.overview: John Constantine wakes up in the eerie House of Mystery with no recollection of how he got there. Fortunately, Zatanna and his friends are all there. Unfortunately, they have a bad habit of turning into demons and ripping him to shreds, over and over again!

results.title: Dead of Night
results.overview: A small town is terrorized by a series of brutal murders, as a determined sheriff, his daughter, and a desperate mayor race to uncover the truth behind the killings before the town descends into chaos.

results.title: Don't Let Go
results.overview: A detective suffering from a personal loss receives a call from his recently deceased niece. Being able to communicate across time, the two work together to try and stop the crime before it occurs.
